checkedAlternates.risk: Spiders are commonly called insects in everyday speech.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Spiders have eight legs and two body sections, which makes them arachnids.

checkedAlternates.risk: Ticks are called bugs and bite like mosquitoes.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Ticks have eight legs as adults and are arachnids, related to spiders and mites.

checkedAlternates.risk: Centipedes crawl like insects and are called bugs.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A centipede has one pair of legs on nearly every body segment, which places it among the myriapods.

checkedAlternates.risk: Shrimp are sometimes called "bugs of the sea".
checkedAlternates.resolution: Shrimp are crustaceans, grouped with crabs.

authorReview.notes: Reveal text names the six-leg and eight-leg rule so the lesson is fair.

blindPlaytest.notes: If testers hesitate over the tick, replace it with a mite or a harvestman and keep the arachnid label.
